hero.subheading: Premium unstitched fabrics & ready-to-wear menswear, curated for the modern Pakistani gentleman.

brandStatement.text: We construct refined ready-to-wear silhouettes and uncompromised unstitched fabrics. Every warp and weft is curated for the modern gentleman who commands understated luxury.

collections.title: Unstitched Fabrics
collections.subtitle: Premium raw textures for complete tailored personalization.

collections.title: Ready to Wear
collections.subtitle: Sharp silhouettes crafted for immediate comfort and style.

blocks.title: Woven Integrity
blocks.body: Every thread of our unstitched fabrics is a testament to heritage craftsmanship. Selected from the finest Egyptian cotton fibers and pure wool blends, our fabrics offer unparalleled drape and hand.

blocks.title: Unrivaled Quality
blocks.body: From crisp linen coordinates to luxurious latha suits, our range adapts to every climate and occasion. We respect the raw properties of fibers to ensure durability, softness, and timelessness.

blocks.title: Decades of Craft
blocks.body: Honoring centuries-old weaving traditions, we collaborate with legendary textile mills to deliver fabrics that command distinction — clothes that live through memory.

trustStrip.title: Nationwide Delivery
trustStrip.body: Complimentary shipping on orders over PKR 10,000. Delivered across Pakistan.

trustStrip.title: Secure Payment
trustStrip.body: Fully encrypted checkout with local debit and cash on delivery support.

trustStrip.title: Prompt Support
trustStrip.body: Direct WhatsApp assistance for fitting advice and order queries.

newsletter.title: Join the Elite
newsletter.body: Subscribe to receive private lookbooks, seasonal fabric drops, and priority access to limited edition collections.
